$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：貪狼獨坐辰戌，《深造講義》p.103。

basis.quote: 须注意其为坚忍，抑为躁进

rules.text: 你的貪狼與火鈴同宮成格，一生必有突發的機遇；只是機遇未到之前急躁冒進，容易先敗，突發之後也較易暴敗。
rules.en: Your Tan Lang shares the palace with Huo or Ling, forming the pattern: a sudden break will come in your life; but rushing before it arrives tends to bring failure first, and after a sudden rise a sudden fall is more likely.

source.quote: 最欢火铃同度成格，则生必有突发的机遇

rules.text: 你的貪狼化祿，未發跡之前容易被欲望推著走，急躁冒進。
rules.en: Your Tan Lang is transformed by Lu, so before you make your mark, desire can push you into rushing.

rules.text: 你的貪狼化權，較腳踏實地。
rules.en: Your Tan Lang is transformed by Quan, which keeps you more grounded.

source.quote: 贪狼化权，则较脚踏实地

rules.text: 你的貪狼化忌，容易因為失意而急躁冒進。
rules.en: Your Tan Lang is transformed by Ji, so disappointment can push you into rushing.

rules.text: 會照的破軍吉化，增加你的堅忍。
rules.en: Po Jun with a favourable transformation in your trine adds to your endurance.

rules.text: 你的盤鈴星、陀羅同會：外表從容，內心焦躁。
rules.en: Ling Xing and Tuo Luo both meet your chart: calm on the outside, restless within.
rules.edit: 原書此條講貪狼不見四化的情形，條件照錄。

source.quote: 而铃陀同会则主外表从容，内心焦躁
